verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail claims a developer API ('use our API directly to take full control of your workflow') plus Zapier integration, indicating some programmatic access exists, but probes for llms.txt, markdown docs, and OpenAPI/Swagger spec all returned 404s, showing no publicly documented API schema was found. missing for 10: publicly accessible API reference/OpenAPI spec, endpoint documentation, authentication details, independent developer corroboration.
